segments.text: Once upon a time, a big golden queen from the stars came to Earth.
She wanted to build tall towers, but some giant green rock people lived there.
They didn't want her to build.
The queen tried to fight them, but it was too hard.
So she made a sneaky plan.
She told little lies to the rock people.
Lies like: "The ocean giants are making bad weather for desert giants." Or: "Forest giants want to take mountain giants' homes." These weren't true, but she made them sound true.
The rock people started believing the lies.
They got mad at each other instead of the star queen.
Slowly, over many years, they stopped being friends.
The queen smiled because now she could build her towers without fighting.
It's a sad story about how lies can break friendships, even between big strong rock people.
